title: Player polled on a timer instead of listening to <video> events
cause: getVideoInfo/notifyPlayerState read the <video> element every loop tick
risk: steady CPU burn during playback; worse on low-end panels
fix: cache values, use timeupdate/progress/ratechange listeners, read only what changed

title: New fetch/WebSocket per PubNub publish
cause: a new request wrapper is created per message instead of reusing one
risk: heap growth over a session while a sender is connected
fix: reuse one client, created when a phone connects and released on disconnect

title: Logger builds strings even when logging is off
cause: callers concatenate before the level check; the level table is rebuilt per call
risk: small constant overhead on every SDK code path
fix: check the level first and build nothing when that level is off

title: Home-page CPU rises with a sender connected
cause: monitor/state functions run every loop iteration even when nothing changed
risk: idle-home cost paid whenever a phone is paired
